pr_title: Fall back to join ping if not master
pr_body:
The `JoinValidationService` doesn't need to send the cluster state if
we're not currently the master - instead it can just send a join ping.
This means it doesn't need to do any work adjusting the blocks.

Closes #97313

issue_context.title: Avoid getStateForMasterService during join validation
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/97304 removes several places that might do an expensive rebuild of the cluster state via `getStateForMasterService`. There's one other call we should be able to remove, in `JoinValidationService`, but it's a little tricky since we rely on seeing the last-accepted state for the cluster UUID validation, and it's not obviously ok to expose the last-accepted state without the no-master block.

This is a fairly minor issue because we do not do this join validation during elections, only if we're the elected master, and in that case `getStateForMasterService` is cheap. But that's not guaranteed, and we should strengthen this to avoid the that expensive step whenever possible.

Sounds good thanks for the explanation!
